meta.scope: Taiwan Batch 7 — Dedicated semiconductor / electronics deep pass. Fleshes out the highest-authority industrial cluster with production detail, science-park performance, policy instruments (Act for Industrial Innovation / ‘Taiwan Chip Act’ provisions), trade and spatial expansion. Explicit referenced_by lists written for maximum force-layout edge strength.
meta.strategy_note: User request: semiconductors are a hot commodity and need to be well fleshed out. This batch treats the semiconductor/electronics complex as a multi-node cluster rather than a single node, so the force mechanisms can form a dense, high-authority sub-graph.

candidates.title: Electronic Components Industry — Production, Sales and Inventory statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Statistics
candidates.description: Detailed monthly/annual statistics on production, sales and inventory value of the electronic components industry (the core statistical category that contains semiconductors and related devices). This series is the primary high-frequency official measure of semiconductor-related manufacturing activity.
referenced_by: Headline Industrial Production Index (electronics components dominate recent growth)
Export orders and customs export statistics for electronics
candidates.notes: Highest-frequency official semiconductor-proxy series. Recent double-digit growth driven by advanced-process and AI-related demand makes this a central pulse node for the entire technology cluster.

candidates.title: Computers, Electronic & Optical Products Industry production statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Statistics
candidates.description: Production statistics for computers, electronic products and optical products — the downstream and equipment-related layer that has been strongly boosted by AI servers, semiconductor equipment and high-performance computing demand.
candidates.notes: Complements the components series. AI-server and semiconductor-equipment demand has produced extreme year-on-year growth rates, creating tight edges into the components and export-order nodes.

candidates.title: Science Parks aggregate revenue, employment and firm statistics (Hsinchu, Central, Southern)
candidates.publisher: National Science and Technology Council / Science Park Administrations
candidates.description: Official statistics on the three major science parks: aggregate revenue (recently record levels driven by the integrated-circuit sector), number of firms, employment, and industry composition. IC sector accounts for the large majority of park revenue.
referenced_by: Regional contrast and Taipei–Hsinchu axis nodes
candidates.notes: Geographic and organisational heart of the semiconductor cluster. Revenue now measured in trillions of NT$; IC sector dominance creates a clear high-authority sub-graph.

candidates.title: Hsinchu Science Park detailed statistics
candidates.description: Detailed statistics for the original and still-core Hsinchu Science Park — firm counts, employment, sales by industry (especially IC), and investment. Remains the densest single locus of advanced semiconductor activity.
referenced_by: Northern Taiwan regional and labour statistics
candidates.notes: Core geographic node of the foundry and design ecosystem. Strengthens the Taipei–Hsinchu axis already flagged in earlier batches.

candidates.title: Southern Taiwan Science Park statistics and semiconductor expansion
candidates.publisher: Southern Taiwan Science Park Bureau / NSTC
candidates.description: Statistics for the Southern Taiwan Science Park, which has recorded the fastest recent growth and is the principal locus of the southward expansion of the semiconductor ‘S-corridor’.
referenced_by: Regional contrast (southward shift of high-tech activity)
candidates.notes: Captures the spatial expansion of the semiconductor cluster beyond the traditional Hsinchu core — important for regional and industrial-policy edges.

candidates.title: Act for Industrial Innovation (產業創新條例) — including ‘Taiwan Chip Act’ provisions (Art. 10-2 etc.)
candidates.publisher: Republic of China (Taiwan) / Ministry of Economic Affairs
candidates.description: Core industrial-policy statute that provides the legal basis for R&D and advanced-process equipment tax incentives (the so-called Taiwan Chip Act provisions), smart-machinery and AI investment incentives, and related industrial-innovation measures. Continuously cited in semiconductor investment and tax-policy analysis.
referenced_by: Semiconductor and R&D investment decisions and announcements
MOEA industrial-policy and tax-incentive utilisation reports
candidates.notes: Highest-value recurring-citation policy node for the semiconductor cluster. The Art. 10-2 incentives (high R&D intensity + advanced-equipment thresholds) are explicitly designed around the foundry and advanced-packaging model.

candidates.title: Semiconductor and electronic-components trade statistics (exports / imports by detailed HS)
candidates.description: Detailed customs trade statistics for electronic components, integrated circuits, semiconductor devices and related products. Semiconductor-related items dominate Taiwan’s export structure and generate large trade surpluses.
referenced_by: Headline trade statistics and BOP goods account
candidates.notes: Trade-side counterpart to the production series. Creates direct edges from the factory floor into the external-surplus and partner-concentration nodes.

candidates.title: Semiconductor / electronics employment and wage statistics
candidates.publisher: DGBAS / Ministry of Labor / Science Park Administrations
candidates.description: Employment counts and earnings levels in electronic components, computers/optical products and science-park IC firms. These segments sit well above average earnings and account for a disproportionate share of high-skill employment.
referenced_by: Labour productivity and unit labour cost (manufacturing)
candidates.notes: Labour-side of the dual structure. High electronics earnings versus the rest of the economy generate clear inequality and household-income edges.

candidates.title: Advanced-process and packaging capacity indicators (official and industry-linked)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / NSTC / industry associations cited in official releases
candidates.description: Indicators and official commentary on leading-edge process nodes (5 nm, 3 nm, 2 nm) and advanced packaging capacity concentrated in Taiwan. While firm-level data are private, the statistical and policy literature continuously references Taiwan’s dominant global share of advanced capacity.
referenced_by: Electronic components production and science-park IC revenue
candidates.notes: Strategic capacity node. Taiwan’s overwhelming share of the most advanced foundry and packaging capacity is the structural reason the semiconductor cluster carries such high authority in any global or regional graph.

candidates.title: Taiwan semiconductor / electronics cluster — overview meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MOEA, NSTC, DGBAS and CBC sources
candidates.description: Meta-node that situates the electronic-components production series, computers/optical production, science-park revenue, Industrial Innovation Act incentives, semiconductor trade, employment and advanced-capacity indicators as a single coherent high-authority industrial complex.
referenced_by: All detailed semiconductor and electronics nodes listed above
National accounts, BOP, R&D and regional statistics that treat electronics as the leading sector
candidates.notes: Explicit cluster-level node so the force layout can treat the entire semiconductor complex as a tightly bound, high-mass object rather than a collection of weakly linked leaves. This is the structural feature the user requested to be ‘well fleshed out’.
